text: Gillette's ultimate parent, The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE: PG), is widely held: per its 2026 proxy statement, its only disclosed 5%+ holders are The Vanguard Group (7.52%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.70%), with no controlling or state shareholder identified.
